description: `shift(15)` moves both fields in one spread (15, 25 — the split writes would trap); `squeeze(30, 3)` breaks `start <= end` and traps before either field is written (both stay 15, 25).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: Ruling S483 item 2: "The grouped write is the existing spread `@r = { ...@r, start: a, end: b }`: one snapshot, all or nothing, checked once."
